column1: # One row per review round. Tab-separated fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), unit, round (continuous per unit across its
# proposal and implementation reviews), classes raised (comma-separated, or - when none), classes that repeated a prior
# round (comma-separated, or - when none), and compliance_misses (findings that were a miss of an existing rule).
# Appended by the main agent from the record line a review round emits; aggregated in the window by
# scripts/review-rounds.py, which the digest's review-rounds block prints.
# Classes come from the canonical list the reviewer's contract carries (`.opencode/agent/review-quick.md`), which makes
# the repeat column and the aggregation comparable; rows recorded before that list landed keep the labels they were
# recorded with, and the mapping from them — recorded in the archived canonical-class-list change's design — is applied
